summary: Swarmer, Inc. filed an 8-K on September 9, 2026, announcing a definitive Participatory Interests Purchase Agreement to acquire 100% of Ratel Robotics (JK Land Vehicles LLC, Ukraine) from four indirect sellers and direct sellers. Consideration comprises an estimated $7.2 million cash at closing, 1,064,942 shares of common stock, up to $7.2 million cash earnout for FY2026 revenue and operating income targets, and up to 4,422,125 shares earnout for FY2026-2028 targets. Closing expected in Q4 2026, subject to customary conditions. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or break fee disclosed. Watch earnout achievability and Ukraine regulatory risk.
